tools.name: find_activity
tools.description: Find the CFO+ activity (of 138, in 11 sectors) that matches a business description, e.g. "عيادة أسنان" or "coffee shop". Returns keys to use with activity_details.

tools.name: activity_details
tools.description:
The questions CFO+ asks for one activity (its drivers), what it sells (revenue lines) and its cost items — names only, as shown on cfoplus.ai.
    Also the input sections every model asks whatever the activity (team and salaries, monthly fixed costs, assets, funding, taxes), worded as on the inputs

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: CFO+ plans and prices as published on cfoplus.ai, the launch offer, the refund guarantee, AI FP&A and the Academy.

tools.name: services_after_the_model
tools.description: The fifteen services that read the same financial model (funding, valuation, files, analysis, follow-up, opportunities), in five families.

tools.name: how_the_numbers_are_made
tools.description: How CFO+ produces its figures: fixed engines, AI explains and never generates, provisional values with sources, and what the checks do and do not mean.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Links to start a free model (three fields: name, email, password), download a finished sample model, or book an AI FP&A demo.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search CFO+ published content: the 138 activities (questions, revenue lines, cost items), plans and prices, services after the model, how figures are made, and the site's FAQ. Returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one search result by its id (activity:…, page:…, faq:…).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_started" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Links to start a free model (three fields: name, email, password), download a finished sample model, or book an AI FP&A demo.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started · Private data: services_after_the_model, get_started · Public sink: get_started.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started · Private data: services_after_the_model, get_started · Public sink: get_started

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
